authority: Frozen design + instrument validation. Same-context analysis. Grants no scientific or promotion authority.
object: The declared open mathematics of the framework: the graded metric on structure space - what does NEAR mean for relation structures (docs/SIMILARITY_ANALOGY_ALGEBRA.md; src/rakl/analogy_retrieval.py v1 refuses to rank by any tunable similarity score).
qoi: What would a principled graded metric require; what validates it; can ARN's third-party labels serve as its first external validation set.
requirements_for_a_principled_graded_met: R1 TYPED, NOT FUSED: distances are per-coordinate on the signature (relation-graph coordinate first); any single fused similarity score is a diagnostic projection only. Consistency note: the no-scalarization theorem (RaklFormal.no_faithful_scalarization) forbids faithful total-ordering of AUTHORITY; retrieval ranking is routing, not authority, so a graded retrieval distance is PERMITTED - but the algebra's Scientific Jump Vector + Pareto frontier (SIMILARITY_ANALOGY_ALGEBRA.md section 8) still applies, so candidate ordering across coordinates stays a frontier, never one number.

R2 TIERED ZERO-SET: the cheap tier's zero-set must coincide with the v1 necessary condition (shape-signature equality); the exact tier's zero-set with relation-graph isomorphism. The graded value interpolates between tiers; the witness obligation (injective role map, transport S3) is discharged at the exact tier only - a small distance NEVER discharges it.
R3 LABEL-FREE: JUMP candidates are vocabulary-disjoint by definition, so the metric may use only unlabeled directed-graph structure.
R4 NO POST-HOC THRESHOLDS: any accept/propose threshold is frozen before result access; the metric itself carries no tunable trained parameters in v1 candidates.
R5 FAIL-CLOSED: empty relation structure returns REFUSED (CANNOT_CHECK), never distance zero.

R6 EXTERNAL VALIDATION ONLY: the metric's semantic claim ('small distance tracks analogy') is validated exclusively against labels whose authors are independent of this programme. Self-authored similarity judgments are the known trap (the Paper II six-family gate was self-authored and non-falsifiable).

candidate_metrics_frozen.M0_exact_signature_v1: incumbent baseline: 0 iff (relation count, degree multiset) equal, else 1 (binary; src/rakl/analogy_retrieval.py semantics reimplemented).
candidate_metrics_frozen.M1_signature_l1: graded on signature space only: normalized |relation-count diff| + L1 between sorted padded degree sequences (declared quasi-metric).
candidate_metrics_frozen.M2_wl3: depth-3 Weisfeiler-Leman refinement on digraphs; distance = 1 - mean multiset-Jaccard of label multisets across depths.
candidate_metrics_frozen.M3_ged_exact: exact normalized graph edit distance via brute-force injection (feasible at n<=7).
candidate_metrics_frozen.M_refuse_all_planted_fail: planted-fail candidate for validating the evaluator itself (always 1.0); the evaluator must reject it.

stage_A_instrument_validation.evaluator: EVALUATOR_STAGE_A.py, sha256 beb4b6303147f889b2d9284f9074c1de080b058ccf19b6fe458071ef8a2fa355; deterministic, stdlib-only; self-test includes a hand-computed GED case, iso-zero checks, refusal on empty structures, degenerate-Spearman convention, determinism, and rejection of the planted-fail candidate. stage_A_instrument_validation.worlds: 40 base digraphs (5-7 nodes, 6-10 edges, seeded); per base: one vocabulary-disjoint isomorphic pair and k=1..4 cumulative-edit graded pairs; 20 signature-equal brute-force-verified non-isomorphic decoy pairs.

MEASURED_evidence: graded_spearman_mean_k1_4 for M1, M2, M3 (edits can cancel; degree-preserving rewires are invisible to M1; genuinely can fail)
decoy_sep_rate for M2 (WL has known non-iso blind spots; genuinely can fail)
CONFORMANCE_not_evidence: iso_zero_rate = 1.0 for M0-M3 (signature/WL/GED invariance under isomorphism is a theorem)
decoy_sep_rate = 0.0 for M0 and M1 (decoys are signature-equal by construction; these metrics are functions of the signature)
decoy_sep_rate = 1.0 for M3 (shares the brute-force isomorphism oracle used to construct decoys - same code, definitionally true)
planted-fail candidate rejected by the evaluator

stage_A_instrument_validation.frozen_thresholds: TRACKS_GRADED iff mean Spearman (k=1..4) >= 0.80; TIER_DISCRIMINATES iff measured decoy separation >= 0.50.
stage_A_instrument_validation.frozen_predictions: M0: Spearman 0.0 (binary blindness - the motivating constraint exhibited); M1: positive but below M3; M2: >= 0.80 and decoy separation >= 0.50; M3: highest Spearman.
stage_A_instrument_validation.licensed_claim_if_pass: ONLY that graded structural distance tracking planted edit distance is implementable within R1-R5 (instrument grade). Nothing about analogy semantics.
stage_A_instrument_validation.execution_host_rule: laptop billy, fresh isolated checkout; results committed as a separate commit AFTER this freeze commit.

stage_B_external_validation.status: FROZEN DESIGN - BLOCKED, not executable now
stage_B_external_validation.question: Does the graded structural distance between reduced structures of (query, candidate) narrative pairs rank third-party-labelled analogies above distractors?
stage_B_external_validation.external_labels: ARN (research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/data/arn.csv, sha-pinned, CC BY 4.0; labels authored by Sourati/Ilievski/Sommerauer/Jiang + validators - mechanically independent of this programme). Primary endpoint: per-query paired comparison (distance(query, analogy) < distance(query, distractor)), reported as paired accuracy with CI; secondary: near/far quadrant breakdown against distractor_similarity/analogy_level columns.
stage_B_external_validation.blocker_and_why_not_executed_now: The metric consumes STRUCTURES; ARN ships prose without gold structures (verified: vendored CSV has no role/relation annotations). Any Stage B run therefore requires a reducer, and the executed Paper II negative (NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT: registered deterministic reducer at chance, witness exact 0.490, retention 0.023) means running Stage B through the current admissible reducer would measure extraction noise, not the metric - an attribution-confounded negative. Executing it anyway would violate the attribute-failure-to-one-stage rule. Stage B is licensed only after a reducer clears admit_reducer at capability (with contamination declaration; ARN public since 2023-10).
stage_B_external_validation.verdict_on_the_mission_question: YES, ARN can serve as the metric's first external validation set - but only JOINTLY with an admissible capable reducer. This is the same shared blocker as the Paper II capability staircase and representation-tournament Contest 2; one admitted reducer unlocks all three.
stage_B_external_validation.controls_frozen: lexical-distance arm; band arm; B2 text-destruction battery on the reducer; shuffled-gold null; trivial-floor check - inherited verbatim from research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/PROTOCOL.json patterns.
stage_B_external_validation.graded_label_successor: StoryAnalogy (SEARCH_LEDGER.md reserve; 24K pairs, human 0-3 relation-similarity ratings) is the better-matched corpus for a GRADED metric (rank correlation against graded human ratings instead of binary accept/reject), at the declared cost of a thresholding degree of freedom and LLM-generated candidate stories (provenance note). Registered as successor, not selected.

must_not_be_claimed: No Stage A pass means the metric captures NEAR in any semantic sense; planted worlds validate instruments, not analogy.
A small graded distance never discharges the witness obligation (injective role map, obstruction check, authority path - analogy_retrieval verification_obligations remain mandatory).
No fused cross-coordinate similarity score may be reported as THE metric.
Stage B may not run through the current deterministic reducer; a Stage B negative under a chance-level reducer would be an apparatus artifact, not a measurement.
M3's decoy separation and all iso_zero rates are conformance cells, never reportable as findings.
